typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	var_BCC as string (),
	var_CC as string (),
	var_Connection_String as string (),
	var_Data_Src as string (),
	var_Dest_Conn as string (),
	var_Dim_MaxSK as integer (),
	var_Dim_Query as string (),
	var_Duplicate_Rec as string (),
	var_Dw_Effective_End_Date as string (),
	var_Dw_Run_Cncl_Dt as timestamp (),
	var_Dw_Run_Eff_Dt as timestamp (),
	var_Dw_Run_Key as integer (),
	var_Dw_Run_Month as integer (),
	var_Email_From as string (),
	var_Email_Subject as string (),
	var_Email_To as string (),
	var_Error_Description as string (),
	var_Error_Flag as integer (),
	var_Initial_Catalog as string (),
	var_Initial_Catalog1 as string (),
	var_Password as string (),
	var_ProjectID as integer (),
	var_Rowcount as integer (),
	var_SMTP_Server as string (),
	var_User_Name as string ()
}
 derive(DW_Current_Flag = toInteger(('0'))) ~> DERCurrentFlag0	source(output(
		CurrentStageID as integer,
		CurrentStage as string,
		DW_Run_Key as integer,
		DW_Upsert_Flag as string,
		Modified as timestamp,
		Created as timestamp
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'select CurrentStageID,CurrentStage,DW_Run_Key,DW_Upsert_Flag,Modified,Created  from src.stg_CurrentStage where DW_Run_Key=?',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLESRCCURRENTSTAGE
DERCurrentFlag0 sink(input(
		DW_Run_Key as integer,
		Modified as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		DW_Current_Flag as integer,
		CurrentStageID as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		DW_Run_Key = Param_0,
		Modified = Param_1,
		DW_Current_Flag = Param_2,
		CurrentStageID = Param_3)) ~> CMDtoUpdateChangingAttribute
OLESRCCURRENTSTAGE derive(DW_Current_Flag = toInteger(('1')),
		D_var_Dw_Effective_End_Date = toDate(toString($var_Dw_Effective_End_Date, 'MM/dd/yyyy'), "MM/dd/yyyy"),
		DW_Update_Run_Key = $var_Dw_Run_Key) ~> DERforCurrentFlagRunKey
DERforCurrentFlagRunKey lookup(TO_BE_FIXED_LOOKUP_KEYS == TO_BE_FIXED_LOOKUP_KEYS,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'first',
	broadcast: 'none')~> SCDCurrentStageCONNECTEDLOOKUP
SCDCurrentStageCONNECTEDLOOKUP derive(SrcDimensionKeys = sha2(256,'')) ~> SCDCurrentStageREFORMATCOMPONENT
SCDCurrentStageREFORMATCOMPONENT select(mapColumn(
		SrcDimensionKeys = SrcDimensionKeys
	),
	 skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	 skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> SCDCurrentStageSELECTCOMPONENT
DERCurrentFlag0,SCDCurrentStageSELECTCOMPONENT union(byName: true) ~> All
All derive(DW_Current_Flag = toInteger(('1'))) ~> DERCurrentFlag
DERCurrentFlag sink(input(
		DW_Current_Flag as integer,
		DW_Effective_End_Date as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		DW_Upsert_Flag as string,
		CurrentStageID as integer,
		DW_Update_Run_Key as integer,
		CurrentStage as string,
		DW_Run_Key as integer,
		DW_Effective_Begin_Date as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		DW_Current_Flag,
		DW_Effective_End_Date = D_var_Dw_Effective_End_Date,
		DW_Upsert_Flag,
		CurrentStageID,
		DW_Update_Run_Key,
		CurrentStage,
		DW_Run_Key,
		DW_Effective_Begin_Date = Created)) ~> OLEDSTDCurrentStage
